contract.block_names: unique ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]{0,127}; 256 declarations per function; entry is first source block; Core __hia_ prefix rejected

contract.function_results: zero to three scalar, owned buffer/chain or parameter-bound borrowed values internally; public f0 remains exactly u32
contract.instruction_results: zero or one; internal calls have zero to three scalar, owned or parameter-bound borrowed results; buffer.try_new has exactly (buffer,bool); chain.try_push/chain.pop have exactly (chain,buffer,bool)
contract.value_names: unique ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]{0,127}; 2048 distinct interned names per function including signature; Core __hia_ prefix rejected
contract.whitespace: ASCII space and LF; shared assembly adjacency rules
